title: Sebastiano Foscarini (Escorial) to the Doge and Senate of Venice, 13 October 1761 (DECODE R1875)

steps.what: Fetched the six images and record metadata with the stored DECODE cookie.
Read signature and address: Sebastian Foscarini, ambassador, Escorial 13 Oct 1761, no. 178 sola.
Zoomed the cipher lines: digits under heavy ink bars, only partly legible.
crittologia.eu: Foscarini's decipherments were written on the despatch and the cipher barred.
Identified the interlinear text of p. 1 and pp. 3-4 as the chancery decipherment (catch-words 'dell'Ecc.mo Senato'; p. 4 ends 'Sono per ogni conto', resumed in clear on p. 5); transcribed it in full.

outcome.notes: Read at the time; sender, recipient and content identified; key not rebuilt.
